Visit note | 2026-06-24 10:30 AM | Dr. Kamrul Hasan, Pulmonology | Patient: Liton Bepari, 73, male. Mr. Bepari returns for review, stating that he has been experiencing wheezing on walking, breathlessness that has been worse for several days, and more sputum than usual. He is a shopkeeper and noted that his respiratory symptoms worsened during the dusty dry season in Jatrabari. He has a known history of Bronchial asthma and currently takes regular inhalers. On examination, his oxygen saturation SpO2 is 86%, while other vitals show BP 120/86 mmHg, pulse 89 bpm, and weight 58 kg. Chest auscultation reveals widespread expiratory wheezes and prolonged expiration. Assessment: COPD exacerbation. Plan: a prescription was issued today. He was strongly advised to stop smoking completely, avoid cooking smoke, and take the yearly flu vaccine. Follow-up is scheduled in 1 week, or sooner if breathing worsens.

Visit note | 2026-06-24 10:30 AM | Dr. Mostafizur Rahman, Orthopedics | Patient: Anwar Molla, 51, male. Mr. Molla presents today complaining of a twisted ankle and pain when walking. Plan: a prescription was issued to manage his pain and inflammation. He was advised to follow rest, ice, compression, and elevation for 48 hours and use a crepe bandage. Follow-up is in 1 week.
